---
title: "Version map"
description: "Mo 68A: Which versions make up an image, and how to read them off Mo 68A."
sidebar_position: 2
---

A Mo 68A image ships a bootloader, a kernel, a Debian desktop system, and TI's
device firmware and TIDL runtime, all under a single firmware version.

## Read the versions off Mo 68A

`/etc/inhand-release` holds the firmware version, the TI SDK release and the
TIDL tag:

```bash
cat /etc/inhand-release
```

```
# PLEASE DO NOT EDIT THIS FILE
MODEL_NAME=Mo68A
FIRMWARE_VERSION=1.0.5
BUILD_TIMESTAMP=2026-11-13T10:15:14Z
TI_SDK_VERSION=11.01.00.03
TIDL_TAG=11_02_17_00
```

The kernel version:

```bash
uname -r
```

The distribution release:

```bash
cat /etc/os-release
```

The Armbian release:

```bash
cat /etc/armbian-release
```

The U-Boot release:

```bash
strings /proc/device-tree/chosen/u-boot,version
```

Together they describe one image. Firmware V1.0.5 reports:

| Component | Value |
|---|---|
| Firmware | `1.0.5` |
| TI SDK release | `11.01.00.03` |
| TIDL tag | `11_02_17_00` |
| Kernel | `6.12.35-vendor-k3-mo68a` |
| Distribution release | `13 (trixie)` |
| Armbian release | `26.02.0-trunk` |
| Bootloader | U-Boot `2025.01` |

## TIDL_TAG is the edgeai-tidl-tools tag your PC must use to compile models

On your PC you use `edgeai-tidl-tools` to compile models, then run inference on
Mo 68A. You must check it out at the same tag as the `TIDL_TAG` in
`/etc/inhand-release`. Compile with any other tag and the model will not load.
[Set up the toolchain](../application-development/ai/toolchain.mdx) covers
installing `edgeai-tidl-tools` on the PC at that tag.
